alberta-student-aid.name: Alberta Student Aid Scholarships

residency.src: Implicit: Alberta Student Aid scholarships require Alberta residency. Most detail pages restate this, but the few that do not still require it.

alberta-student-aid.disclaimer: Unofficial mirror of the Alberta Student Aid scholarship listings. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of Alberta. Verify anything time-sensitive against https://studentaid.alberta.ca/scholarships/.

electrofed.name: Electro-Federation Canada Scholarships

citizenship.src: Weak, deliberately below the 0.75 exclusion threshold: EFC scholarships are for students at Canadian institutions and most restate a citizenship or residency requirement, but the association does not state one globally, so this must never exclude anyone on its own.

electrofed.disclaimer: Unofficial mirror of the Electro-Federation Canada scholarship listings. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Electro-Federation Canada. Apply through EFC's own application centre at https://scholarship.electrofed.com/.

scholarab.name: ScholarAB (Alberta scholarship directory)
scholarab.blocked_reason: The database is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Reuse is expressly permitted with attribution, but ShareAlike would require releasing this project's entire published dataset — including the UW and AcademicWorks records — under the same licence. Excluded on that basis, not on robots, which allows everything but /api/. Used for source discovery only; verified 2026-09-27.

scholarshipscanada.name: ScholarshipsCanada.com
scholarshipscanada.blocked_reason: Crawl permission unverifiable — Cloudflare 403s /robots.txt and the Terms of Service page 404s (checked 2026-09-26). Unreadable directives are treated as disallow. Resolve by contacting the operator for written permission.

scholartree.name: ScholarTree
scholartree.blocked_reason: Prohibited by robots.txt (Disallow: /scholarships and /graphql) AND by Terms of Service §3, which forbids automated or manual extraction. Account also required to browse. Not revisitable without explicit written permission.

uoft.name: University of Toronto Award Explorer
uoft.blocked_reason: award-explorer.utoronto.ca/robots.txt disallows crawling the Award Explorer. The same report is reachable on the vendor host uoftscholarships.smartsimple.com, whose robots.txt 404s, but an absent file on a third-party SaaS host is not permission from UofT — and this project respects robots.txt strictly (see sources/blocked/awardspring.yaml, excluded the same way at a cost of ~2,100 awards). Costs ~4,490 awards. Resolvable by asking UofT Student Accounts in writing; verified 2026-09-27.
